molecules.name: Insulin
molecules.role: Master 'storage' hormone — suppresses lipolysis, drives glucose uptake (GLUT4), activates DNL via SREBP-1c

molecules.name: Leptin
molecules.role: Adipose-derived satiety signal to hypothalamus — proportional to fat mass; resistance drives obesity

molecules.name: Growth Hormone (GH / somatotropin)
molecules.label_th: โกรทฮอร์โมน
molecules.role: Pulsatile lipolytic + muscle-sparing hormone; amplified during fasting and deep sleep

molecules.name: Ghrelin
molecules.role: 'Hunger hormone' from stomach — pre-meal spike; elevated by sleep deprivation

molecules.name: Cortisol
molecules.role: Stress hormone — raises hepatic glucose, promotes visceral fat deposition when chronically high

molecules.name: GLP-1 (Glucagon-like Peptide 1)
molecules.role: Enhances insulin secretion, slows gastric emptying, reduces appetite (target of semaglutide/tirzepatide)

molecules.name: Adiponectin
molecules.label_th: อะดิโพเนกติน
molecules.role: Insulin-sensitizing, anti-inflammatory adipokine — inversely correlated with visceral fat

molecules.name: Hormone-Sensitive Lipase (HSL)
molecules.label_th: ฮอร์โมน-เซนซิทีฟไลเปส
molecules.role: Hydrolyzes stored triglyceride → FFA + glycerol; activated by PKA/catecholamines, suppressed by insulin

molecules.name: Adipose Triglyceride Lipase (ATGL)
molecules.role: Catalyzes the first and rate-limiting step of triglyceride hydrolysis in adipocytes

molecules.name: Lipoprotein Lipase (LPL)
molecules.role: Hydrolyzes circulating TG in VLDL/chylomicrons → FFAs taken up by tissue; upregulated by insulin in adipose

molecules.name: GLUT4
molecules.role: Insulin-responsive glucose transporter in muscle + adipose; translocates to plasma membrane when insulin binds

molecules.name: UCP1 (Uncoupling Protein 1 / thermogenin)
molecules.role: Uncouples oxidative phosphorylation — dissipates proton gradient as heat; signature of brown adipocytes

molecules.name: AMPK (AMP-activated protein kinase)
molecules.role: 'Fuel sensor' activated by low ATP — stimulates catabolism (fat oxidation) + inhibits anabolism (lipogenesis)

molecules.name: mTOR (mechanistic target of rapamycin)
molecules.role: Growth master-switch; when active suppresses autophagy; activated by amino acids/insulin

molecules.name: SREBP-1c (Sterol Regulatory Element-Binding Protein 1c)
molecules.role: Insulin-activated master regulator of de novo lipogenesis genes (FAS, ACC, SCD-1)

molecules.name: β-Hydroxybutyrate (BHB)
molecules.label_th: เบตา-ไฮดรอกซีบิวทิเรต
molecules.role: Dominant circulating ketone during fasting/keto; crosses BBB as brain fuel; also signaling molecule (HDAC inhibitor)

molecules.name: Acetoacetate
molecules.label_th: อะซีโตอะซีเตต
molecules.role: Primary ketone produced in liver; converted to BHB or spontaneously decarboxylated to acetone

molecules.name: Glycogen
molecules.role: Storage form of glucose (liver ~100-120 g, muscle ~400 g); first fuel depleted during fasting

case_studies.name: Angus Barbieri
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Fasted 382 consecutive days (1965-66) under medical supervision at Maryfield Hospital; weight dropped from 456 lb (207 kg) to 180 lb (82 kg); maintained loss 5 years later
case_studies.source: Stewart WK & Fleming LW, Postgrad Med J 1973 (PMC2495396)

case_studies.name: Counterpoint Study (Lim et al. 2011)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 8-week 600 kcal/day VLCD reversed T2D — liver glucose output normalized in 7 days; beta-cell function recovered over 8 weeks
case_studies.source: Lim EL et al., Diabetologia 2011; summarized in Taylor 2021 PMC8247294

case_studies.name: DiRECT Trial (Lean et al. 2018)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Primary-care VLCD program — 46% T2D remission at 12 months; 64% remission in those losing ≥10 kg
case_studies.source: Lean MEJ et al., Lancet 2018; summarized in Taylor 2021 PMC8247294

case_studies.name: Cold-Activated BAT Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 24 healthy men, 16°C cold for 2h — 23/24 (96%) showed active BAT on PET-CT; lean had ~4× activity of obese
case_studies.source: van Marken Lichtenbelt WD et al., NEJM 2009 (NEJMoa0808718)

case_studies.name: Ho 1988 GH-Fasting Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 6 healthy men — 5-day fast increased 24-hour GH pulse frequency from 5.8±0.7 to 9.9 pulses and amplified pulse amplitudes
case_studies.source: Ho KY et al., J Clin Invest 1988 (PMC329619)

case_studies.name: Ohsumi Autophagy Work
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Discovered ATG genes in yeast under starvation → mapped autophagosome formation machinery — basis of 2016 Nobel Prize in Medicine
